text:
ria: Heads-up: scheduling quant-kernel v5.2-alpha push to canary tonight 00:30 PT via deploy-bot. Need signoff on pin-ttl, initial traffic %, and rollback triggers. TL;DR: aiming for 5% canary for 30m, auto-throttle if latency P95 > 200ms or cpu OOM/eviction. Thoughts?

jon: What's the canary smoke checklist? Need perf and correctness. Can we run the small eval set and memtop during canary?

ria: Smoke checklist inline:
- run: ./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --model gpt-q --suite smoke-small
- meters: p95_latency, 99th_cpu, kv-cache-hit
- acceptance: p95 <= 120ms, error-rate < 0.5%
Also run:
```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime-canary -n staging --tail=200 | grep -i oom
./infra/monitor.sh --check p95_latency --window 5m
```

samir: +1 to 5% starter. Suggest pin-ttl 4h. Rollback triggers: (1) p95 >200ms for >5m OR (2) error-rate spike >1% OR (3) OOM on >2 hosts within 10m. Fallback target: v5.1-quant (non-alpha).

sre-marta: Please ensure deploy-bot has backoff enabled, and set auto-throttle to 50% if we see CPU contention. Also add alert channel #eng-runtime on trigger. I'll create an incident alert rule.

lucy: Release notes draft for docs: "quant-kernel v5.2-alpha: improved matmul tiling, experimental int8 path, expect lower token-cost for long context. Not for production; opt-in via deployment flags." Anyone has safe wording for the int8 claim? Keep conservative.

ria: Wording suggestion: "experimental int8 execution path for select ops; performance varies by model and prompt length. Use with caution"

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiated canary rollout for release/quant-kernel-v5.2-alpha to runtime-canary pool. 20 hosts targeted (5% traffic). Link: https://deploy.redwood/integrations/6201112222

jon: Noted. I'll run smoke in ~15m and post results.

samir: Quick config tweak for canary resource requests — bump cpu to 2v and mem to 8Gi for canary only. Patch:
```
kubectl -n runtime patch deployment runtime-canary --patch 'spec: {template:{spec:{containers:[{name:"runtime", resources:{requests:{cpu:"2",memory:"8Gi"}}}]}}}'
```

ria: Done. Deploy-bot picked up the patch and re-queued canary. Expect 00:45 PT spin-up.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started: 5% traffic, pinned for 4h TTL. Auto-throttle rule attached.

sre-marta: I'll be watching, ping me @sre-marta if alerts fire. Also set a canary-CW to force rollback if any of the triggers happen.

lucy: I'll drop release note into the changelog PR and ping docs.

jon: Smoke results: p95=115ms, error-rate=0.12%, kv-hit stable. No OOM. LGTM for initial slice. :thumbsup: 

ria: Thanks. Keeping this thread for any immediate rollbacks. If we need to rollback, reply "ROLLBACK NOW" and tag deploy-bot.

samir: ack.

sre-marta: ack.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: monitoring hooks active. Will post final status at 01:15 PT.

(End of thread)
